github_repositories: Public GitHub repositories of Global Health Engineering

Source: R/github_repositories.R
github_repositories.Rd

One row per public repository in the organisations whose repositories are listed. Private repositories are not in this table. Public repositories whose name contains the user name of a person are left out as well, and so are repositories that carry a degree in their name (student work) and all repositories of organisations that name exercises after the people who work on them. The column repos_listed of github_organisations says how many repositories of an organisation are in this table.

Usage

github_repositories

Format

A tibble with 10 variables

organisation

Login of the GitHub organisation that owns the repository.

repository

Name of the public repository.

created_date

Date the repository was created.

pushed_date

Date of the last push to the repository before the snapshot date.

is_archived

TRUE when the repository is archived.

is_fork

TRUE when the repository is a fork of another repository.

license

SPDX identifier of the licence that GitHub detects. NA when there is none or GitHub cannot name it.

primary_language

Main language of the repository as detected by GitHub. NA when there is none.

repository_type

Type of the repository, see github_repository_types for the rules. Levels in this table: data package, student project, hardware, manuscript, organisation profile, proposal or report, research project, software, teaching and training, template, website and communication, group management.

commits_total

Number of commits on the default branch up to the last complete month before the snapshot date, made by people, without merge commits, commits by bots and automated commits. NA for forks.

Source

GitHub REST API, read with data-raw/data_processing_github.R.

Details

The table has a total number of commits per repository and no monthly series, because most repositories have one contributor.
